questions.text: Let $\Sigma = \{a, b\}$ and let $L = \{w \in \Sigma^* \mid w \ne \epsilon \text{ and the first and last character of } w \text{ are the same}\}$. Design a DFA for $L$.
Let $\Sigma = \{a, b, c\}$ and let $L = \{w \in \Sigma^* \mid \text{some character in } \Sigma \text{ appears at most twice in } w\}$. Design an NFA for $L$.
Let $\Sigma = \{a, b\}$ and let $L = \{w \in \Sigma^* \mid w \text{ is a non-empty string whose characters alternate between } a\text{'s and } b\text{'s}\}$. Design a DFA for $L$.

questions.text:
Write a regular expression for the following languages.

- i) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's such that no prefix has two more 0's than 1's, not two more 1's than 0's.
- ii) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's whose number of 0's is divisible by 5 and number of 1's is even.

Using Pumping lemma, show that the following languages are not regular.

- i) $L = \{0^n 1 0^n \mid n \ge 1\}$
- ii) $L = \{0^i \mid i \text{ is a perfect square}\}$
Use Table filling algorithm to minimize the following DFA.

figures.alt: DFA with states a, b, c, d, e, f. A start arrow enters a. c, d and e are accepting (double circles). Transitions: a to b on 0; b to a on 0; a to c on 1; b to d on 1; c to e on 0; c to f on 1; d to e on 0; d to f on 1; e self-loop on 0; e to f on 1; f self-loop on 0, 1.

questions.text: Write a short note on (i). Reversal, (ii) Homomorphisms, (iii) Finiteness test.
Prove the three properties of pumping Lemma for regular languages.

Consider the grammar:

$$\begin{aligned}
S &\to ASA \mid aB \\
A &\to B \mid S \\
B &\to b \mid \epsilon
\end{aligned}$$

- i) Eliminate $\epsilon$ productions.
- ii) Eliminate unit productions in the resulting grammar from (i).
- iii) Eliminate useless productions in the resulting grammar from (ii).
- iv) Put the grammar from (iii) in Chomsky Normal Form (CNF).
Is Context-free language (CFL) closed under Union and Intersection? Verify your answer.

Find Context-free grammar for the following languages:

- i) $L = \{a^i b^j c^k \mid i,j,k \ge 0 \text{ and } i + j = k\}$
- ii) $L = \{a^i b^j \mid i,j \ge 0 \text{ and } i \ne 2j\}$

Design Pushdown Automata (PDA) to accept the language:

$D = \{a^i b^j c^k \mid i,j,k \ge 0 \text{ and } i = j \text{ or } j = k\}$.

- ii) Circuit Satisfiability Problem

Prove that "PDAs that are accepted by final state and empty stack are equivalent."

- i) $L = \{ww \mid w \text{ is in } \{0,1\}^*\}$
